notes.title: Minor patch
notes.content:
3.0.16: Very minor patch for steam only. 

- Fixed Mac unable to launch. Thanks to those who spotted it and solved it for others!
- Fixed resurrecting heroes not working under some circumstances
- Can under/over-pick modifiers by a little more
- New monster- golem! Sort of, they were in the game but not tagged for any zones by mistake. "steam-exclusive" until the other platforms update.
- Changed Bag of Holding because it's too much for the game to handle combined with other meta-items
- Swap one fighter for lazy in tutorial run
- Bell passive now works with rmon
- Pilgrim locked behind an early achievement.
